arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' ORDER BY name

SELECT 'config' AS source, service AS id, value AS detail FROM service_config
UNION ALL SELECT 'flight', flight_id, json_object('capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights
UNION ALL SELECT 'cache', key, value FROM cache
UNION ALL SELECT 'booking', booking_id, json_object('request',request_id,'flight',flight_id,'passenger',passenger_id,'amount',amount_cents,'status',status,'client_reference',client_reference) FROM bookings WHERE status != 'confirmed'
UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',event_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered'
UNION ALL SELECT 'customer_event',event_id,json_object('request',request_id,'kind',kind,'step',step) FROM customer_events
UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',charge_id,json_object('booking',booking_id,'key',idempotency_key,'amount',amount_cents,'state',state,'step',created_step) FROM charges WHERE state != 'captured'
